suite: MISACS Phase 3 Qualified Simulation Suite (Screening Task 7 Submission)

results.name: 24V Input TVS Clamping and Reverse Protection
results.model_type: Parametric Diode & TVS Static DC-Sweep Macro
results.fidelity: Static DC sweep (Rsrc=0.5 ohm); models reverse blocking of D2, forward clamp of D14 reverse-polarity shunt diode, and breakdown of SMBJ30A. Does not simulate dynamic high-energy lightning/surge transients or dynamic reverse-polarity fuse clearing.
results.engineering_qualification_notes: Static simulation passes under stated DC model. Engineering qualification CONDITIONAL / NOT VERIFIED: verifies static protection behavior under stated model, but does not prove dynamic reverse-polarity fuse coordination. D14 survival under actual installation fault conditions remains unverified (unpublished total-clearing I^2t, source impedance dependency).
quantitative_findings: Vin=+50V: V(fused)=44.020V, V(prot)=43.558V (Margin to 60V LM2576=15.98V)
Simulation Model: Parametric Diode & TVS Static DC-Sweep Macro (Nominal Static Rsrc=0.5 ohm)

Qualification Note: Verifies static protection behaviour under stated model; does not prove dynamic reverse-polarity fuse coordination. D14 survival under actual installation fault conditions remains unverified (clearing I^2t unpublished, installation-dependent)
Engineering Qualification Status: CONDITIONAL / NOT VERIFIED (Simulation Execution: PASS)

results.name: LM2576-5.0 Buck Switching Power Stage
results.fidelity: Open-loop 52kHz pulse switch with Bourns SRR1260-101M (100uH, 1.70A sat, 180mR worst-case DCR) and SS56 catch diode macro. Does not model closed-loop LM2576 error amplifier dynamics, loop compensation, or line/load step transient response.
results.engineering_qualification_notes: Fully qualified under specified simulation model fidelity.
quantitative_findings: 1.5-2.0ms: Mean=4.993V (limit 4.90-5.10V), Ripple=67.59mVpp (limit <=100mVpp)

results.name: AMS1117-3.3 Series Distributed Ceramic Output Network
results.model_type: Behavioural LDO Macro with Series Distributed PCB Trace Network
results.fidelity: Behavioural dropout voltage macro with physical series Rtrace (18mR) and Ltrace (16nH), C4 local MLCC (8.0uF derated), and C10 bulk MLCC (8.5uF derated) at 285.3mA peak load. Evaluates DC dropout transfer and DC trace drop (5.14mV); does not establish AC loop stability, phase margin, or dynamic Wi-Fi pulsed load stability.
results.engineering_qualification_notes: The simulation verifies the behavioural LDO's DC dropout response and distributed PCB trace drop. It does not establish AMS1117 AC loop stability, phase margin, or stability under dynamic ESP32 Wi-Fi pulsed loads. Physical prototype testing is required.
quantitative_findings: Vin=3.5V: Vout=2.386V (Dropout corner)
Vin=5.0V: Vout(local)=3.2857V, Vout(mcu)=3.2806V, Series Trace Drop=5.14mV (limit 4.50-5.80mV)
Simulation Model: Behavioural LDO Macro with Series Distributed PCB Trace Network
Qualification Note: Verifies DC dropout and series trace drop; does not establish AC loop stability, phase margin, or dynamic Wi-Fi pulsed load stability. Physical prototype testing required.
Engineering Qualification Status: NOT VERIFIED (Simulation Execution: PASS)

results.name: ADS1115 Input Overvoltage Clamping
results.model_type: Generic Parameterized Schottky Diode Macro (Nominal 25°C, Fixed 3.3V DC Rail)
results.fidelity: Generic parameterized Schottky diode macro under nominal room-temperature (25°C) static DC sweep with fixed 3.30V rail. Not a vendor-qualified worst-case BAT54S model; does not simulate sub-zero VF curves, ADS1115 internal ESD diode conduction, or dynamic 3.3V rail rise.
results.engineering_qualification_notes: Nominal room-temperature simulation passes. Engineering qualification CONDITIONAL / NOT VERIFIED: at -40°C, typical VF (~0.45V) yields negative voltage margin to ADS1115 absolute maximum limits; 405 V/s rail-rise is a first-order initial-slope estimate under deep sleep (<100µA load, 15.8µF derated capacitance), not a transient simulation or destruction guarantee; dynamic model and physical validation required.
quantitative_findings: Fault=-5.0V: Protected V(adc_pin)=-0.281V (limit -0.30V to -0.25V), Lower Clamp Current=4.72mA
Fault=+10.0V: Protected V(adc_pin)=3.591V (limit 3.50V to 3.60V max), Rail Injection Current=6.41mA into +3.3V
Simulation Model: Generic Parameterized Schottky Diode Macro (Nominal 25°C, Fixed 3.30V DC Rail, Active MCU Load Assumed)

Qualification Note: Sub-zero VF (~0.45V at -40°C typical) yields negative voltage margin to ADS1115 absolute limits; 405 V/s rail-rise is a first-order initial-slope estimate under deep sleep (<100µA load, 15.8µF derated capacitance), not a transient simulation or destruction guarantee; dynamic model and bench validation required
Engineering Qualification Status: CONDITIONAL / NOT VERIFIED (Simulation Execution: PASS)

results.name: RS-485 Differential Bus Signaling
results.model_type: RS-485 Differential Bus Signaling with Ideal Pulse Stimulus, 390R Bias, and 60R Termination
results.fidelity: Ideal pulse source stimulus into dual 120 ohm termination (60 ohm equivalent load) with 390 ohm fail-safe pull-up and pull-down bias network. Models differential bus voltage swing and passive bias levels; does not model physical MAX3485E transceiver driver output impedance, slew-rate control, or common-mode rejection.
results.engineering_qualification_notes: Fully qualified under specified simulation model fidelity.
quantitative_findings: Differential States: Positive Mark=+1.150V (>= +0.80V), Negative Space=-0.951V (<= -0.80V)
Dynamic Differential Eye Swing: 2.10Vpp (TIA/EIA-485 spec >= 1.50Vpp, acceptance >= 1.80Vpp)
